Keep this week simple and familiar so it works around office hours, canteen lunch, and late dinners. The portions are intentionally filling, with enough food to support your evening gym sessions while keeping the calorie gap mild.

Day 1 (Monday)

Breakfast, 09:30
Have a grilled soya sandwich made with 4 whole wheat bread slices, 35g dry soya granules cooked and seasoned, tomato, onion, coriander chutney and 1 tsp oil. Have 1 regular chai with about 150ml milk alongside it.
(P: 35g | C: 78g | F: 12g | ~560 kcal)

Lunch, 14:00
Choose the office thali with 3 rotis, 2 katoris cooked dal, 1 katori sabzi, 1 small bowl curd, salad, and request roughly 2 tsp oil total in the meal. Skip tinda if it is part of the sabzi that day.
(P: 35g | C: 105g | F: 25g | ~785 kcal)

Snacks, 17:00
Have 60g roasted chana, 1 medium banana, and 250ml milk. This is easy to keep at your desk and should prevent arriving at training overly hungry.
(P: 20g | C: 65g | F: 15g | ~475 kcal)

Dinner, 22:30
Have 3 rotis with soya chunk masala made from 60g dry soya chunks, 1 katori cooked dal, and 1 katori sabzi. Use 2 tsp oil total for the soya and sabzi. Add lemon, jeera, coriander and chilli for flavour rather than extra oil.
(P: 45g | C: 100g | F: 20g | ~760 kcal)
